facts.fact: Article 90 of Law 21/2011, signed 14 February 2012, provides that every learner receives from entry to the first pre-primary section a unique coded identification number assigned by the central file of the ministry in charge of National Education, kept until entry into working life; article 94 has the orientation secretariat draw up its list of new baccalaureate holders from that central identification file.

systems.country_label: fichier central du Ministère en charge de l'Education Nationale; fichier central d'identification
systems.owner: Ministry in charge of National Education
systems.tiers: provided for in law for every learner from pre-primary to entry into working life; the law does not say whether it operates or who fills it

note: Classed emis as a learner register (one number per learner). The law creates the identifier and names the ministry's central file; it states nothing on whether the file exists in use, how records are kept, or which schools take part, so only ownership is recorded.
